name: PTDE/DSR exact material EnvSpec router V1

semantics.PRESENT: PTDE and DSR PHN material families both expose the EnvSpec-capable Spc route; PTDE EnvSpec semantic is USE.
semantics.EXPLICIT_NONE: PTDE declared PHN material family has no EnvSpec lane while DSR added an Spc/EnvSpec-capable route; PTDE EnvSpec semantic is NO_USE.
semantics.NOSPC_HOST: PTDE and DSR are both no-Spc PHN hosts; PTDE EnvSpec semantic is NO_USE and no DSR-only EnvSpec suppression is required.
semantics.explicit_none_safe: Carrier authorization only. True for the 20 clean SPC_INSERT_ONLY materials where historical V3 permitted explicit black/none replacement. False does not change PTDE semantic NO_USE; it requires fail-open/preserve-host unless another exact deletion carrier is proven.
